# SECTION 8: WHAT WE AUTO-GENERATE

**Based on your 25 quick answers, our agents will automatically research and create:**

## ✅ Sections Auto-Generated Based on Industry & Business Model:

- **Market Analysis** (TAM/SAM/SOM, market trends, growth rates)
- **Competitor Landscape** (Top competitors, positioning, benchmarks)
- **Go-to-Market Strategy** (Sales channels, customer acquisition, pricing strategy)
- **Operations Plan** (Supply chain, delivery model, technology stack)
- **5-Year Financial Projections** (Revenue, expenses, profitability, cash flow)
- **Unit Economics** (CAC, LTV, payback period, margin targets)
- **Risk Assessment** (Industry-specific risks with mitigation strategies)
- **Strategic Roadmap** (Detailed milestones, KPIs, success metrics)
- **Funding Strategy** (Use of funds breakdown, investor expectations, exit scenarios)
- **Executive Summary** (Investor-ready overview)
